### Grace and Peace from the Father and the Son
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/grace-and-peace-from-the-father-and-the-son
Passage: 2 Corinthians 1:1-2
Points:
- Sanctification can be slow and believers may face setbacks, yet God promises to complete His work in them.
- Paul opened his letter to the troubled Corinthian church with a blessing of grace and peace following painful relational strain.
- Grace is God’s unmerited favor shown in sending Jesus Christ to redeem sinners.
- Faith in Christ establishes true, everlasting peace with God rather than an unstable, temporary cease-fire.
- Believers are called to respond to God's permanent peace by dedicating their lives to serving Him.
